summary: Vertiv Holdings Co filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0625 per share. The dividend is payable on June 25, 2026 to holders of record on June 15, 2026. The board declared the dividend on June 3, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation event, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard current report on other events with no extraordinary implications. No further action or risk arb angle exists; watch for ongoing dividend policy evolution.
